description: This file contains the implementation of clock setting functions for Realtek RTL838X SRAM, including setting DRAM rates, switching clocks, and related hardware register manipulations.

methods.name: rtcl_838x_dram_start
methods.description: Entry point for DRAM start sequence, initializes SRAM clock settings.

methods.name: rtcl_838x_dram_set_rate
methods.description: Sets the DRAM clock rate, enabling dynamic frequency adjustments based on input parameters.

methods.name: rtcl_838x_dram_size
methods.description: Provides size information of the DRAM.
